title: A Orbit for the Gravity
author: Dominic Oyelaran
blurb: Hazel Joubert, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
